lines.trans: While the previous episode of Entertainment Talk was taping, this news article went up.
It described in detail how the two of you sincerely reconciled one minute before taping.
And how with one voice you blamed Xingtian for poor studio service.
That bizarre article was deleted within minutes of going online.
Had the chief editor's office not shut the door on your recording that day, it would have spread across the internet.

We have already written up the whole affair of that fake report going live and getting scrubbed.
One word from Mr Chun Yuqiao and our article goes out.

examples.trans: That internet is good.

examples.trans: We wrote an article on that fake report going up and vanishing.

examples.text: 新闻工作者绝不能发布任何虚假消息。
examples.trans: Journalists must never publish fabricated news.

meanings.note: Conjunction suīrán paired with 但是 ('although ...').

examples.text: 虽然暂时停播，但是我们肯定拍下一季。
examples.trans: Although paused for now, we will definitely shoot next season.

examples.text: 虽然工作很累，但是她很开心。
examples.trans: Although work is tiring, she is happy.

examples.text: 被我全搞砸了，我该怎么办啊？
examples.trans: I ruined the whole thing — what should I do?

examples.text: 这是被。

要不是.gloss: if it were not for, had it not been for

meanings.en: if it were not for, had it not been for
meanings.note: Counterfactual conjunction yàobúshì ('were it not for').

examples.text: 那天要不是总编室拦住，假新闻早传遍了。
examples.trans: Had the editorial office not stopped them, the fake story would have spread.

examples.text: 要不是你及时提醒，我差点忘了带工牌。
examples.trans: If you had not reminded me, I would have forgotten my badge.

examples.text: 方老师让我等你一起。
examples.trans: Professor Fang asked me to wait for you so we could go together.

examples.text: 方老师让我等你一起。
examples.trans: Professor Fang asked me to wait for you so we could go together.

examples.text: 文章详细描写了二位在后台和解。
examples.trans: The article described in detail how you two reconciled.

examples.text: 小谷把彩排流程做成了详细的表格。
examples.trans: Xiaogu turned the rehearsal schedule into a detailed chart.

examples.trans: That would be wonderful, thank you!

examples.text: 等到违约金的钱一到位，合约就结束了。
examples.trans: Once the penalty money clears, the contract ends.

闭门羹.gloss: a slammed door, cold refusal to meet

meanings.en: a slammed door, cold refusal to meet
meanings.note: Idiom noun bìméngēng ('eat a closed-door refusal').

examples.text: 那天要不是总编室给二位吃了闭门羹。
examples.trans: Had the editorial office not turned you two away at the door...

examples.text: 记者没提前预约，结果在门口吃了闭门羹。
examples.trans: Arriving without an appointment, the reporter was turned away.
